#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
OUTPUT_PATH="${OUTPUT_PATH:-/tmp/crypto-feature.jpg}"
RESULT_FILE="/tmp/crypto-feature-result.txt"
ERROR_LOG="/tmp/crypto-feature-error.log"
LOCK_FILE="/tmp/crypto-feature.lock"
MAX_RETRIES=3
BIFROST_BASE_URL="${BIFROST_BASE_URL:-http://192.168.32.1:8888/v1}"
GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT="${GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT:-}"
GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION="${GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION:-us-central1}"
IMAGE_SIZE="1024x576"

# Color codes
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m'

# Functions
log_info() { echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
log_warn() { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
log_error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; }

# Single-flight lock
lock_file="${LOCK_FILE}-${OUTPUT_PATH##*/}"
retry_counter=0
while [ -f "$lock_file" ]; do
  log_warn "Image generation lock file exists: $lock_file"
  if [ $retry_counter -ge 10 ]; then
    log_error "Failed to acquire lock after 10 attempts"
    cat "$ERROR_LOG" 2>/dev/null || echo "No error log available"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 2
  retry_counter=$((retry_counter + 1))
done
touch "$lock_file"

# Cleanup on exit
trap 'rm -f "$lock_file"' EXIT

# Validate prompt
if [ -z "${1:-}" ]; then
  log_error "No prompt provided"
  echo "No prompt provided" > "$ERROR_LOG"
  exit 1
fi
PROMPT="$1"

# Check Bifrost availability
log_info "Checking Bifrost availability at $BIFROST_BASE_URL"
if ! curl -s --connect-timeout 5 -f "$BIFROST_BASE_URL/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log_error "Bifrost is not available at $BIFROST_BASE_URL"
  echo "Bifrost is not available at $BIFROST_BASE_URL" > "$ERROR_LOG"
  exit 1
fi

# Get project config if available
STAMP_LOGO=1
PROJECT_LOGO=""
if [ -f ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json ]; then
  PROJECT_LOGO=$(jq -r '.defaultProject // ""' ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json 2>/dev/null || true)
fi

if [ -n "$PROJECT_LOGO" ] && [ -f "$PROJECT_LOGO" ]; then
  STAMP_LOGO=1
else
  STAMP_LOGO=0
fi

# Attempt generation
for model in "vertex/imagen-4.0-fast-generate-001" "vertex/imagen-4.0-generate-001"; do
  log_info "Attempt $((retry_counter + 1))/$MAX_RETRIES with model: $model"

  # Prepare payload
  DATA=$(jq -n \
    --arg model "$model" \
    --arg prompt "$PROMPT" \
    --arg height "${IMAGE_SIZE#*x}" \
    --arg width "${IMAGE_SIZE%x*}" \
    --arg project "$GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT" \
    --arg location "$GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION" \
    '{
      generator: {
        model: $model,
        prompt: $prompt,
        params: { height: $height | tonumber, width: $width | tonumber, project: $project, location: $location }
      }
    }')

  # Call Bifrost
  if ! RESPONSE=$(curl -s --max-time 180 -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$DATA" \
    "$BIFROST_BASE_URL/generations" 2>&1); then
    log_warn "Bifrost API call failed for model $model"
    echo "$RESPONSE" > "$ERROR_LOG"
    continue
  fi

  # Parse response
  URL=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r --arg model "$model" '.data[] | select(.model == $model) | url' 2>/dev/null || true)

  if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
    log_warn "No image URL found in response for model $model"
    echo "Response: $RESPONSE" > "$ERROR_LOG"
    continue
  fi

  # Download image
  log_info "Downloading image from $URL"
  TEMP_OUTPUT=$(mktemp)
  if ! curl -s --max-time 180 -f "$URL" -o "$TEMP_OUTPUT"; then
    log_warn "Failed to download image"
    echo "Download failed for model $model" > "$ERROR_LOG"
    rm -f "$TEMP_OUTPUT"
    continue
  fi

  # Validate image
  if ! file -b "$TEMP_OUTPUT" | grep -qi "image"; then
    log_warn "Downloaded file is not a valid image"
    echo "Downloaded file is not a valid image" > "$ERROR_LOG"
    rm -f "$TEMP_OUTPUT"
    continue
  fi

  # Stamp logo if configured
  if [ "$STAMP_LOGO" -eq 1 ]; then
    LOGO_FILE=<redacted>
    if [ -f "$LOGO_FILE" ]; then
      log_info "Stamping logo..."
      TEMP_FINAL=$(mktemp)
      convert "$TEMP_OUTPUT" -gravity south-east -geometry +10+10 -compose dissolve - dissolve 30 "xc:,("$LOGO_FILE")" $TEMP_FINAL 2>/dev/null && \
        mv "$TEMP_FINAL" "$TEMP_OUTPUT"
    fi
  fi

  # Copy to final output
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUTPUT_PATH")"
  cp "$TEMP_OUTPUT" "$OUTPUT_PATH"
  rm -f "$TEMP_OUTPUT"

  # Record success
  echo "$OUTPUT_PATH" > "$RESULT_FILE"

  log_info "Image successfully generated at $OUTPUT_PATH"
  exit 0
done

# All attempts failed
log_error "All generation attempts failed"
cat "$ERROR_LOG" > "$(dirname "$ERROR_LOG")/image-error.log"
exit 1
